description: Check the most you can add as a credit card surcharge given your cost, the card network cap and any state cap, and what the customer pays. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version, reference-value notes (official figure or your figure, with source and effective date), a check link and a source-page URL. Official reference values are prefilled when omitted; supply every other figure from the user's records. Percent fields take percent numbers. No figures are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

card.description: Card type. Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for card type. Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: credit = Credit card; debit = Debit or prepaid card.

chosen.description: Surcharge you plan to charge. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. The percent you want to add to card sales.

cost.description: Your card acceptance cost. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Your effective processing cost for this card type as a percent of the sale, from your statement.

networkCap.description: Card network cap. Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. Visa caps a credit surcharge at the lower of your merchant discount rate or 3%. Other networks set their own rules; change this if needed. Official reference value 3% from Visa, Merchant surcharging Q&A (version 02152024), effective 2024-02-15. Omit to use it; enter your own figure to override. The result notes say which was used.

state.description: Your state rule (check it yourself). Use matching records or an explicitly identified assumption for your state rule (check it yourself). Unknown is not the same as zero. Options: none = No state percentage cap; cap = The state sets a percentage cap; banned = The state bans surcharges.

stateCap.description: State surcharge cap (your figure). Percent number: 6.2 means 6.2%. The percentage cap in your state law, as you have confirmed it. Used only when state is cap; ignored otherwise.

ticket.description: Ticket amount before surcharge (US dollars). The sale amount before tax, tip and any surcharge.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.

name: buscalc_credit_card_surcharge_limit_check

checkURL.description: Link that replays this calculation on https://buscalc.com/sumtru/verify/. Null when the inputs hold free-form text or the link would be too long.

notes.description: Reference-value notes first, then model notes and the standard limit statement.

referenceValues.description: One entry per official reference value in play: the official figure, the figure used, status official or user, source, effective date and the note text.

sealURL.description: Where a saved record of this result can be sealed with an independent timestamp.

title: Credit card surcharge limit check
